name: zapi-mcp
description: Zabbix API for Claude Code, via an API user. Investigate active problems, hosts, and item values, get a one-shot daily_brief health check, acknowledge problems, and open maintenance windows. Site-specific daily_brief categories (DHCP pool usage, SNAT usage, core-network, …) need a local ZABBIX_CATEGORIES_INI file that this plugin's own settings cannot supply on someone else's machine; without it daily_brief still works with just the built-in Active Problems / In Maintenance sections. Requires ZABBIX_URL, ZABBIX_USER, and ZABBIX_PASSWORD.
